en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree-lined boulevard with café tables and chairs arranged on a wide sidewalk in front of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand near an open automobile, and more pedestrians walk along the street. In the background rises a tall church tower and other civic buildings. The caption at the bottom reads "Kronstadt. Rudolfsring." The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard with a purple oval stamp reading "LAZAR ERHOVITZ GALAȚI" and small vertical publisher text in German along the left edge.
